messages.author: Fuka
messages.text: Welcome to the Official ReviewTechUSA Discord! There is a few things you have to read before joining. After you do so done feel free to introduce yourself in #💬general ! If you are having trouble getting access to the server go to #❗important-must-read or one of the @Admin .

messages.author: Fuka
messages.text:
1. Be Respectful to Others
Please treat the other members & staff with respect.

2. Nothing that breaks Discord's TOS
You can read the full TOS [here](https://discord.com/guidelines)

3. Try to keep politics to the respected channel
Try to keep politics to the Ranting & Politics channel.

4. No NSFW / Adult Content
This includes artwork and IRL content. This includes stuff with visible genitals, nipples and such. Some suggestive content is allowed but will be judged on a case by case basis.

5. Don't Wish/Threaten harm on Anyone, Including Yourself
Please don't wish harm onto others, especially yourself. None of us our therapist and we are not equipped to deal with self harm threats. If you or you know someone that is going through something please reach out for help, you are not alone. Please text Discord to 741741 for help. 

6. No Doxing & Targeted Harassment
Do not post personal information, Doesn't matter if its publicly available or not. And please don't do Targeted Attacks against other content creators or people, no matter how bad of a person they are. It does not help the situation. 

7. Don't use Racial or slurs. And any other type of hate speech
This will not tolerate people that do so. You will be banned.

8. Please talk to staff if something is wrong
Don't be afraid to go to the staff if there is a problem. But if a staff member needs to talk to you in a urgent manner, please talk to them or reach out to another staff members.

9. Just have fun
If you are not having fun you are doing something wrong.
